senses.gloss: f. (b. h.; = דנת, , Arab, dîn corresp. to our w.)

units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 2:13">Esth. R. to I, 8</cite> <he>כדַת כל מקום וכ׳</he> in accordance with the usages of &c.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:6">Keth. VII, 6</cite> <he>דַּת משה</he> Mosaic (ritual) law, <he>ד׳ יהודית</he> Jewish custom (chastity, decency); <cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:6">Tosef. ib. VII, 6</cite> <he>ד׳ משה וישראל</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 7:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>שעברו על הדת</he> who disregard the Jewish custom.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4:5">Esth. R. to I, 15</cite> <he>כדת</he> just dealing, v. <cite ref="A01683"><he>אַכְזְרִיּוּת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Megillah 12a:17">Meg. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>ד׳ של תורה</he> the Biblical dues (sacrifices); a. fr.
<cite ref="Sukkah 56b:5">Succ. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>המירה דָתָהּ</he> (<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 4:28">Tosef. ib. IV, 28</cite> <he>נשתמדה</he>) she changed her faith, became an apostate.
Yeb. 70ᵇ; Pes. 96ᵃ (ref. to Ex. XII, 43, v. דְּרָשָׁא) בו המרת דת וכ׳ to eat of it (the passover lamb) apostasy does unfit, but &c.—Pl. דָּתִין.

<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 7:19:4">Koh. R. to VII, 19</cite> (play on <he>ידותון</he>, <cite ref="I Chronicles 25:3">I Chr. XXV, 3</cite>) <he>הנבא על הד׳ ועל הדינין וכ׳</he> (Asaph) who prophesied over the judgments and dispensations that passed over him; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> (corr. acc.). [As to derivation of our w. from the Persian, v. Ges. H. Dict.<sup>10</sup> s. v.]
